name: What is the difference between a pool builder and an outdoor living contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a pool builder and an outdoor living contractor in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What is the difference between a pool builder and an outdoor living contractor in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pool builder usually concentrates on the pool itself: excavation, shell construction, plumbing, electrical, equipment installation, plaster, tile, coping, and startup. An outdoor living contractor can take on the larger backyard scope, including hardscape, patios, retaining walls, outdoor kitchens, pergolas, lighting, drainage, turf, and planting. For homeowners planning a true backyard transformation, a single contractor managing both the pool and outdoor elements often creates a cleaner schedule, fewer handoff problems, and more consistent design. It also helps with sequencing, because patios, drains, gas lines, and electrical conduit often need to coordinate with the pool layout before concrete is poured. If you are comparing firms, ask whether they self-perform the work or subcontract major phases, and whether one project manager oversees the whole job. That distinction matters more than the company title on the website.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pool builder focuses on the pool shell, plumbing, electrical, and equipment, while an outdoor living contractor can manage the entire backyard, including patios, decks, kitchens, fire features, drainage, lighting, and landscaping. One contractor handling everything usually improves coordination and reduces scheduling gaps.
